accepted_claim: For every n >= 1, precisely the all-real-spectrum Segre/Jordan types occur on a nonempty open subset of R^n for a smooth compactly supported real Nijenhuis tensor, with arbitrary prescribed numerical real eigenvalues and block sizes.
prior_result_credit: Bolsinov–Konyaev–Matveev Theorem 6.1 supplies necessity; the original source already credits the real semisimple and two-dimensional Jordan examples.
